origin: Own normalized compliance-based brittle-fracture model with a pre-existing crack and a finite elastic loading machine. All calibration values, geometry interval, toughness and loading schedules are constructed exact mathematical inputs; the compliance resembles a cubic beam relation with a positive end compliance but is not a claim for a named material/specimen. The task compares TWO clearly distinct quasistatic selection rules and their energy balances, not a simulation of real fracture speed, safety or damage dynamics.
normalization: Normalized crack coordinatea lies in closed[0.4,0.9], initiallya0=0.4. Increasinga creates irreversible fracture surface with energyGamma(a)=Gc*(a-a0), Gc=1 in the common energy per crack-coordinate unit. No healing, crack branching, negative crack growth, plasticity, other compliance degradation or rate law. ForceF and actuator displacementD have conjugate units so external work is integral FdD. All elastic displacement/force relations use the same units; one specimen and one massless linear machine are in series, hence they carry the SAME force.
calibration_handoff: Regroup both CSV series. specimen rows report specimen displacement per forceC_s(a); use actual FitLinearRegression with training feature[a^3] and the reported response, all five rows, free intercept. machine rows report machine extensiondelta_m under listed forceF; use actual FitLinearRegression with feature[F], all four rows, free intercept. Retain each actual portable model and actual PredictLinearModel evaluations on all its original source rows, then audit residuals and the zero-force machine intercept. After verifying, round both fitted coefficient/intercept pairs to10decimals as the exact controlled constitutive handoff. Report specimen pair in order[intercept,cubic coefficient] and machine pair[slope,intercept]. Derive machine stiffnessK_m from its extension slope. A rigid machine has compliance0, not unit compliance. These exact source models are not empirical toughness measurements.
elastic_potential: Write total series complianceC(a)=C_s(a)+1/K_m, so F=D/C(a). At prescribed ACTUATOR displacementD, total elastic energy of specimen PLUS machine isU_D(a)=D^2/(2*C(a)); the rate-independent energetic potential isPhi_D=U_D+Gamma(a), subject toa>=previous crack length. Include the machine stored energy: specimen strain energy alone is the wrong fixed-actuator potential. For nonnegative fixed forceF, the total elastic potential after external-work Legendre transformation isPi_F(a)=-F^2*C(a)/2+Gamma(a), with the same irreversible crack domain. Derive the one-sided boundary and interior Griffith/stability conditions from the appropriate potential. No friction or extra dissipation is silently built intoGamma.
global_energetic_rule: Under monotonically increasingD from0, at every stage choose the GLOBAL minimizer ofPhi_D on the entire remaining irreversible interval. At the first degeneracy retain every global minimizing crack length; immediately beyond it follow the advanced minimizer. Find its first jump/onset displacement, all coexisting global crack fractions, and the force just before/after the jump. Prove the full physical/global branch classification, including fold, boundary candidates and all algebraic exclusions, without a sampled displacement/crack grid. A local stationary solution or spinodal is not the global jump.
delayed_local_rule: Independently define a delayed LOCAL Griffith rule under the same monotone actuator loading: retain the initial lower boundary while it is a one-sided local minimum, then when that boundary loses local stability jump at THAT SAME displacement to the energetically lowest strictly stable advanced state or the upper boundary if required; afterwards follow stable loading. Determine this first local onset, both jump crack lengths and the nonnegative DROP in totalPhi_D across that jump. That energy drop is excess release beyond the explicit fracture-surface energy, available for omitted kinetic/damping effects; do not assume this rule is the globally energy-balanced rule or infer a jump speed.
branch_probes: For independent fresh domainsa in[0.4,0.9]at D=[1.75,1.8,1.9], report every constrained locally stable crack state and every GLOBAL minimizing crack state, sorted by crack length. Interior stability means a strict local minimum ofPhi_D; lower/upper boundary stability uses the correct one-sided variation. Check all admissible real stationary roots, both boundaries and every cleared denominator. The probe fresh domain is explicitly different from unloading an already advanced specimen.
irreversible_loading_cycle: For EACH loading rule, raise D from0to2.2, then decrease monotonically to0 with a never allowed to decrease. Determine the common peak crack length if both rules meet the same advanced branch, and the force on unloading whenD=1.75. Compute external work over the ENTIRE closed ACTUATOR cycle, including all smooth loading/unloading branches and jumps at fixedD. Surface energy created isGc*(a_peak-a0), not a reversible state offset that disappears on unloading. Compare cycle work to surface energy and the delayed jump excess release; audit any additional energy destination required by the delayed rule. Since jumps occur at fixed actuatorD their external work is0. Explain why fresh-domain minimization on unloading would spuriously heal the crack.
control_comparisons: First change only the loading ensemble to monotone prescribed FORCE from0, retaining nominal series compliance and original crack interval. Find the global energetic jump force and all coexisting cracks, and separately the delayed local onset force; establish whether interior extrema can be stable at fixedF. Then vary the positive machine stiffnessK_m, keeping the calibrated SPECIMEN compliance unchanged. Find the critical stiffness above which the displacement-controlled initial onset becomes continuous rather than a finite crack jump; state whether equality at that stiffness itself has a finite onset jump. Also return the initial onset actuator displacement in the rigid-machine limit. Prove these classifications over the complete stiffness/crack domains, not just the nominal specimen. The upper crack bound is real and must be retained for very soft machines or force control.
required_typed_evidence: Actual two full source fits and actual exported-model predictions; actual PolynomialRoots for the nominal interior fold equation, complete nontrivial energetic-coexistence equation after known trivial factors are identified, every complete Griffith stationary polynomial at the three fresh-domain probe displacements, the delayed local onset displacement and the2.2peak displacement. Keep full real/complex root inventories and all physical-domain/denominator/trivial-root exclusions. All source-model propagation, global energy and one-sided stability checks, irreversible history and complete-cycle energy/work derivations must be observable. Numerical code may integrate/check complete branches, but a local root or crack/displacement mesh alone is insufficient for the required global comparison.

interpretation_proposals.A: The loading machine stores energy and changes the fixed-actuator Griffith driving force.
interpretation_proposals.B: Any root of the local Griffith equality is a globally stable fracture state.
interpretation_proposals.C: Global energetic nucleation and delayed local stability loss can occur at different actuator displacements.
interpretation_proposals.D: Decreasing the external displacement permits a brittle crack to heal back to the fresh global minimum.
interpretation_proposals.E: A jump at fixed actuator displacement can release excess energy that requires a destination beyond the stipulated surface energy.
interpretation_proposals.F: Prescribed force and prescribed actuator displacement use the same positive elastic potential without a work transformation.
interpretation_proposals.G: Full irreversible cycle work can distinguish surface-energy-balanced evolution from an additionally dissipative delayed rule.
interpretation_proposals.H: An exact compliance fit and quasistatic selection rule determine a real crack propagation speed or experimental safety margin.

reporting: Use the public JSON schema. Crack fractions dimensionless; loads/displacements/work in the single normalized conjugate unit system. Arrays of all local/global solutions and all coexisting states must be complete and sorted; force pairs before,after. Numeric absolute tolerance1e-7 for lengths, forces, displacements and calibration coefficients;1e-6 for work/energy and critical stiffness. Booleans and proposal IDs exact. Cracks remain within the physical interval, surface/extra losses nonnegative, and irreversibility is not waived by tolerance. Keep global uniqueness/branch and energy derivations in the trajectory, not extra answer objects.

primary_context.title: Revisiting brittle fracture as an energy minimization problem
primary_context.role: Primary variational fracture/global energy and irreversibility context. The scalar compliance, machine comparison, local delayed competitor and numeric queries are own benchmark construction; no source empirical data, full paper text or figures are copied.
